title: The Forbidden Fruit of AI
description:
**Category:** Poster Design, Conceptual Art

Artificial intelligence has become a modern equivalent of the biblical forbidden fruit, a symbol of knowledge that both fascinates and unsettles humanity.

The poster reinterprets the story of Adam and Eve, a familiar subject in art history, depicted by artists such as Lucas Cranach the Elder and Albrecht Dürer. Just as the fruit from the Tree of Knowledge promised a new understanding of the world, AI offers unprecedented possibilities: uncovering the mysteries of the universe, curing diseases, and predicting the future.

Yet these possibilities raise an ancient question. Could the pursuit of knowledge become a curse? Will embracing artificial intelligence make us wiser, or will we lose something essential to our humanity?

The poster explores the tension between curiosity and fear, technological progress and its potential consequences.
